question.problem:
The linear transformation $T$ and the vector $b\in {R}^{4}$ are given below. Determine if there exists a vector $x\in {R}^{4}$ such that $T(x)=b.$
In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}-{x}_{4},$ where ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},{x}_{3},{x}_{4}$ are the components of $x.$  

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3} \\ {x}_{4}\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+2{x}_{4}+2{x}_{3} \\ 5{x}_{2}-7{x}_{4}-3{x}_{1}-{x}_{3} \\ 4{x}_{2}+{x}_{4}+5{x}_{3}+2{x}_{1} \\ -7{x}_{3}-{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}-{x}_{4}\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -8 \\ -9 \\ 10\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
First, we write down the standard matrix of $T:$

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 \\ -3 & 5 & -1 & -7 \\ 2 & 4 & 5 & 1 \\ -1 & -1 & -7 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

Since $T$ is the standard matix of $T,$ we have $\text{Im}(T)=\text{Col}(T).$ In order to determine whether $b$ lies in $\text{Im}(T),$ we need to check if the equation $Tx=b$ is consistent. 

So, let's find the row echelon form of the augmented matrix $[T\,|\,b]$ as follows: 

$$
\begin{aligned}[T\,|\,b] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 & 3 \\ -3 & 5 & -1 & -7 & -8 \\ 2 & 4 & 5 & 1 & -9 \\ -1 & -1 & -7 & -1 & 10\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1} \\ {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-2){R}_{1} \\ {R}_{4}:={R}_{4}+{R}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 2 & 5 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 6 & 1 & -3 & -15 \\ 0 & -2 & -5 & 1 & 13\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}-3{R}_{2} \\ {R}_{4}:={R}_{4}+{R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 2 & 5 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -14 & 0 & -18 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 14\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

From the foruth equation, we get the false statement $0=14.$ Therefore, the system is inconsistent, and we conclude that  $b\notin \text{Im}(T).$
